issues.description: Method de.tum.in.ase.eist.service.PersonService.addParent(Person, Person): the problem statement and the template declare and expect addParent to be publicly callable (used by PersonResource and unit/integration tests), but the solution implementation declares the method as private. PersonResource (src/.../rest/PersonResource.java) and PersonServiceTest (src/.../test/PersonServiceTest.java) call personService.addParent(...). Declaring addParent as private prevents those callers from compiling or running against the solution code and will block students or automated tests from invoking the service method as specified by the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility of addParent in PersonService to public to match the problem statement, template, PersonResource callers and tests. For example, declare 'public Person addParent(Person person, Person parent) { ... }' and keep the existing implementation logic. Ensure the method signature and access level are consistent across template, solution and tests so callers in different packages can invoke it.
